mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS image_id, i.image_no AS image_code, i.image_type, i.growth_stage, i.health_status, i.collected_location AS collect_place, i.collected_at AS collect_time, r.final_species_name, r.final_confidence, r.result_source, r.match_result, r.need_review, r.review_status, r.suggestion FROM herb_image i LEFT JOIN herb_identification_result r ON r.id = ( SELECT latest.id FROM herb_identification_result latest WHERE latest.image_id = i.id AND latest.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest.identify_time DESC, latest.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.id = #{imageId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT m.match_rank AS rank_no, COALESCE(m.herb_name, s.herb_name) AS species_name, m.image_similarity AS similarity, COALESCE(a.atlas_no, CONCAT('atlas-', a.id)) AS atlas_name FROM herb_image_match m LEFT JOIN herb_atlas a ON a.id = m.atlas_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = COALESCE(m.species_id, a.species_id) AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.image_id = #{imageId} AND m.remark = ( SELECT mm.remark FROM herb_image_match mm WHERE mm.image_id = #{imageId} AND mm.remark IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY m.match_rank ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(s.herb_name, r.recognized_herb_name) AS species_name, r.confidence, r.reason, r.suggestion FROM herb_image_recognition r LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = r.species_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.image_id = #{imageId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.rank_no ASC LIMIT 1
